|gr1= PhysX

|descr= {{Wiki|WIP}} Requires that a swing+twist or SLERP "drive" has been configured in [[attachChild]].
Sets the joints target orientation (relative to the joint's own orientation).
The drive will then behave like a spring (springParameters are configured in the drive), trying to pull the child object to the desired orientation.

|s1= joint [[setJointDriveOrientation]] [angle, axis]

|p1= joint : [[Object]] or [[NetObject]] - The parent vehicle that has a joint to a child, or the joint itself to be manipulated

|p2= angle: [[Number]] - The angle (in radians to rotate around axis), clockwise

|p3= axis: [[Vector3D]] - The vector around which to rotate

|r1= [[Nothing]] 

|s2= joint [[setJointDriveOrientation]] [vectorDir, vectorUp]

|p21= joint : [[Object]] or [[NetObject]] - The parent vehicle that has a joint to a child, or the joint itself to be manipulated

|p22= vectorDir: [[Vector3D]] - [[vectorDir]]

|p23= vectorUp: [[Vector3D]] - [[vectorUp]]

|x1= <sqf></sqf>

|x2= <sqf></sqf>

|x3= <sqf></sqf>

|x4= <sqf></sqf>

|x5= <sqf></sqf>
